description: This PHP source file defines a function get_body which prepares a Smarty template with form data and configuration for rendering an HTML form element, specifically connected to the Dynamic Fields module in SuiteCRM. It includes handling of default values, language strings, and TinyMCE editor configuration.

classes.name: SugarTinyMCE
classes.description: A class used to configure the TinyMCE WYSIWYG editor within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_body
methods.description: Prepares and populates a Smarty template with form data, language strings, and editor configuration, then fetches the rendered template.
